description:
Who We Are 

 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 

 What We Offer 

 Location:
Rehovot,ISR 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 
 We are looking for a talented Algorithm Research Engineer with deep mathematical and statistical expertise to join our Material Metrology Algorithm team. This is a research-oriented role focused on solving complex real-world problems from first principles: formulating them mathematically, analyzing large volumes of data, developing statistical methods and simulations, and turning the research into robust, working product solutions.
   
 About Us 
 Our team develops the next-generation material metrology algorithms for a new semiconductor platform that provides material composition information, as well as traditional imaging. We are a small, hands-on team in which engineers are involved across multiple aspects of the product. We combine rigorous mathematical and statistical research with practical implementation, and work closely with application and field teams to deliver solutions that have a direct impact on the semiconductor manufacturing industry.
  
 What’s in it for you? 
 Join a world-class team working on a new, highly innovative product in the semiconductor industry.
 Solve challenging problems that require deep mathematical and statistical thinking, often where no established solution exists.
 Take your research from first principles all the way to a working solution used by customers.
 Help shape the evolution of the product’s algorithms, with room for creative development.
 Enjoy a small, collaborative, creative, and research-driven environment.
 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Develop and extend algorithms grounded in strong mathematical and statistical foundations, starting from first principles where no established solution exists.
 Analyze large volumes of data and extract meaningful, reliable information from complex and noisy signals.
 Perform in-depth statistical analysis and data-driven investigation to identify the underlying mathematical relationships and physical phenomena.
 Build and run simulations, derive insights, and connect the results to actual measurements and product behavior.
 Implement research ideas, models, and simulations in Python or similar programming environments.
 Work closely with application engineers and field teams, including occasional visits to customer sites to understand the data and train and support local teams.
 Contribute new ideas and approaches as the product evolves
 
 What You Should Have 
 Ph.D/M.Sc in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related quantitative field, with 5+ years of relevant experience. Highly relevant Ph.D. or postdoctoral research without industry experience will also be considered.
 Deep mathematical understanding and strong statistical foundations, with proven experience developing algorithms or research solutions from first principles.
 Experience extracting meaningful information from complex signals or large datasets, e.g., in signal processing, statistical signal analysis, RF, spectroscopy, microscopy, or similar signal-intensive domains.
 Hands-on experience in mathematical modeling and simulation.
 Strong practical programming skills, particularly in Python, with a demonstrated ability to translate theory into practical implementations.
 Curiosity, creativity, and a hands-on approach to solving real-world technical problems.
 Ability to work collaboratively in a small team and alongside customer-facing engineers.
 Willingness to travel occasionally to international customer sites
 Experience applying machine learning techniques on top of a strong statistical foundation is an advantage.
 Experience with spectroscopy-based or semiconductor metrology applications is an advantage.
  
 
 
 Additional Information 
 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Yes, 10% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
No 
 
 Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
